desc:
Amazon ongoing management starts with a plan and a first round of real work. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your seller account, agrees a task list, then completes listing checks, ad review, inventory and order checks, an account health check and a written report.

## What does Amazon account management include?

Account management is the regular care that keeps a seller account running well. It covers listing quality, advertising, stock levels, orders and buyer messages, and account health. Each area needs a little attention often, rather than a big effort once.

Our starter plan packages that care into one sprint. We review the account, agree which tasks matter most, complete them, and give you a written summary. If you want continued monthly support afterwards, we quote it separately, based on what your account actually needed.

## Why accounts drift without a routine

Amazon seller accounts do not stand still. Stock runs down, prices change, competitors appear, and warnings arrive. A listing that lost its main image goes unnoticed for weeks. An ad campaign keeps spending on a term that never sells. A shipment plan is forgotten until a best seller is gone.

Owners who also run the business, handle suppliers and answer customers rarely have time for a weekly review. Small issues then grow quietly. A fixed routine catches them while they are cheap to fix.

## How steady care affects results

Regular checks protect three things: availability, visibility and standing. Availability means products are in stock and the listing is active. Visibility means titles, images and ads still match what shoppers search for. Standing means the account health measures stay inside Amazon's limits.

A weekly rhythm of checks also gives you data. After a month you can see which products carry the account, which ads earn their budget and which tasks keep recurring. That clarity lets you decide what to improve next. Sales still depend on your product, price and market, and we do not promise a result.

## What a good starter sprint includes

- An account review covering listings, ads, stock, orders and health.
- A written task list ranked by effect and effort.
- Listing checks for titles, images, attributes and suppression.
- A review of advertising campaigns with bid changes.
- Inventory and order checks with notes on restocking.
- An account health check with fixes for any open warnings.
- A weekly calendar so you know what is done when.
- Progress updates in the higher packages.
- A written summary, with a sales report and a three-month plan at the top level.

## How the work runs

We begin with the account review and a call or message exchange to agree priorities. A routine task is a small, defined job: fixing a suppressed listing, refreshing a bullet set, adjusting a bid, checking a shipment, or replying to a policy notice. We count these against the number included in your package.

We do the tasks in your own Seller Central account, record each one, and send updates at the pace your package sets. At the end you receive a summary of what was done, what we found and what we suggest next. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages grow in the number of tasks, listings checked and update frequency. This is a one-time sprint, not a subscription, unless you ask for a monthly plan.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your top priorities before the review starts.
- Share any past warnings and what was done about them.
- Keep stock and supplier information current.
- Reply to our questions within a day or two.
- Decide early whether you want a monthly plan afterwards.

**Avoid:**
- Handing over everything without saying what matters most.
- Making big changes in your account while our sprint is running.
- Sharing your login instead of inviting a user.
- Expecting a single sprint to fix months of neglect.
- Ignoring the summary and next-step list.

## Who this is for

This service suits a busy owner who sells on Amazon alongside other work. It also suits a seller who has taken over an account from a previous manager and wants a clear view of its state. A newer brand that wants a trusted routine before it scales can use it to build one.

## What we need from you

Please send your priorities, any known problems and a note on which tasks you want left alone. You invite us as a user in your Seller Central account with the permissions agreed. We never ask for your password, and we keep a record of every change.
